Implement IDEA-030: evidence correctness, free-source ingestion, and real component integration

Repository: /Users/songyaozhu/binance-hackathon

The architecture and owner components already exist. Improve and integrate them; do not rebuild the project. The objective is reliable, auditable trading with a defensible chance of improving after-cost returns in the Binance challenge. More news, more trades, and more conservative vetoes are not success metrics by themselves.

Scope and budget

Implement the engineering corrections and free-source path in IDEA-030. The data/licensing budget is zero. Use existing EDGAR plus free sources with usable content rights; do not subscribe, pay, contact vendors, scrape unlicensed news, or treat a free API tier/RSS feed as a licence. Do not deploy, trade, sign, upload real audit logs, run paid models, or train a return model as part of this task. Offline implementation, fixtures and safe public-source connectivity checks are in scope. Existing economic-policy decisions remain separate: locate explicit adoption records before assuming any baseline or evidence authority was adopted. Preserve existing mandatory risk controls and DEVELOPMENT/SHADOW defaults where adoption is unresolved; implement/test configurable authority without activating it. New uncertain-event/news influence stays disabled or shadow-only until its own prospective economic gate passes.

Read and establish the actual starting state

1. Read AGENTS.md, docs/skill/SKILL.md using its reading rules, the docs/LEDGER.md table and relevant docs/INCOMPLETE_WORK.md items.
2. Read docs/ledger/IDEA-030.md, IDEA-030-probes.md and IDEA-030-free-sources.md; then IDEA-029 and only the relevant owner build records/contracts. IDEA-030's pinned SHAs describe the reviewed state, not necessarily today's state.
3. Fetch and inspect current branches/PRs before editing. The existing work was on codex/evidence-agent, codex/strategy-risk-research, codex/runtime-audit-platform and codex/engine-foundation; branch-isaac appeared during the follow-up. Locate renamed/merged equivalents. Main may contain documentation before owner code. Do not mistake an absent main module for an unbuilt component. The IDEA-023 ID was independently used for different records on owner/main branches: preserve both histories and reconcile references explicitly.
4. Use a suitable current checkout or a codex/ integration branch. Incorporate the necessary existing committed components through ordinary merges/selective integration, preserving others' changes. Never force-push, rebase, amend pushed commits or reset pushed history. Preserve the pre-existing untracked Claude outputs/ directory; do not run or commit it.
5. Record a staged implementation plan and acceptance criteria under the next genuinely free ledger ID, cross-linked to IDEA-030 and GAP-67. Commit and push prospective criteria and every code change affecting decisions/trades/logging before running that code, including relevant tests. If pushing is blocked, continue static work but do not execute unpushed affected code.

A. Repair evidence semantics first

Represent separately: the source/report and attribution, the proposition being asserted, actor, affected issuer, event type, certainty/conditionality, announcement time, effective/event time, publication/version time and actual receipt time. Reuse existing schemas where possible and version incompatible changes.

Distinguish occurred events, confirmed announcements of future events, attributed rumors/forecasts, generic conditional risks and agent-generated scenarios. Preserve useful uncertainty without promoting it to an occurred fact. Source authority verifies what a source said; it does not make an allegation true or establish price direction. A regulator filing a complaint is not a finding of guilt; a proposed rule is not an effective rule.

Correct the confirmed examples in IDEA-030: headings assert no occurrence; a competitor's cyber incident is not the issuer's incident; a CEO rumor is not a confirmed departure; an announced future resignation retains announcement certainty and future effective time. Handle negation, quoted/third-party text, historical repetition and mixed clauses. Do not solve this only by adding modal keywords. Unsupported deterministic findings must not survive verification or model abstention as actionable facts. Retain supported facts when other claims fail, with coverage/uncertainty explicit.

Partial supported facts remain available for audit and reassessment. Their retention alone must not upgrade ABSTAIN to CLEAR, authorize entry or expand mandatory-exit authority. Any independently verified deterministic risk predicate must still satisfy its explicit configured authority and acceptance checks.

Verify signed numerical value, metric, period, units, issuer and REPORTED/GUIDANCE kind together. Reject sign and kind mutations with an unchanged span. Account for parentheses/minus signs, losses and guidance ranges. Preserve valid positive and negative controls; rejecting everything is not acceptable.

Support attributed development/capability claims without pretending that chip breakthroughs fit the existing five adverse event codes. Keep any relationship to an eligible issuer separately sourced, with an unknown effect allowed. Do not infer that a competitor announcement is bearish for both NVIDIA and SK hynix, assign invented probabilities, or build a general knowledge graph as a prerequisite.

B. Complete novelty, review and freshness behavior

Separate exact-text change, semantic change, first-seen status and unavailable prior history. Stable event/statement identity must survive the same document being reread, syndicated copies and harmless paraphrases; substantive new facts/corrections must remain distinguishable. Bound comparisons and expose uncertain matches.

Persist acknowledgment, pending review, supersession/correction, expiry and resolution. An unchanged filing must not create an endless NEW/review loop. An unrelated clean document must not erase an unresolved concern. Use bounded retries/backoff and explicit exhaustion; no human intervention is assumed during the scored run.

Keep evidence state separate from portfolio permission: a novel hypothetical alone must not silently become an entry veto. Assess stored freshness at consumption time; rejected/expired incoming results must not leave an old CLEAR usable forever. Preserve adverse latches until their explicit resolution rules are satisfied. Bound document bytes, facts, tokens/work, history scans and elapsed time, not just tool calls; report truncation and incomplete coverage.

C. Connect the real components

Define one canonical assessment/context contract or explicit versioned adapters covering issuer/token identity, times, status/quality, supporting evidence, falsifiers and context hashing. Missing or incompatible records must produce visible typed rejection, not silently disappear. Reconcile strategy/runtime context, plan jobs, intent amount and expiry, decision identity, reservations, persisted risk state and reassessment scheduling.

Add an integration fixture using the actual ingest -> assessor/verifier -> durable evidence state -> strategy -> independent planner -> store/outbox modules. Fake only external sources, model and execution; do not replace a producer with a handcrafted dictionary matching its consumer. Verify stale contexts, duplicate results, restarts and corrections.

Preserve existing mandatory terminal flattening. Locate the adoption record for falsifier-exit authority, or test the configurable alternatives without enabling one. Where explicitly configured as mandatory, reductions must reach reduction constraints and bypass discretionary cadence/minimum/profitability gates, while retaining affordability, signing and integrity checks. Do not make every policy EXIT mandatory. Do not fabricate quoted depth, underlying-share history, price-source rights or basis validation to make entry tests pass. Where a policy value or price-impact replacement is genuinely undecided, expose the capability blocker and record the exact remaining decision.

D. Add the smallest useful free-source basket

Use IDEA-030-free-sources.md as the researched starting register, then verify current endpoints and per-content terms. First implement SEC official news, Federal Register/BIS documents including public inspection, and DOJ original releases. Add EC original press releases through the shared adapter once its response/rights checks pass. FTC is useful but its tested RSS links failed: support a documented permitted working retrieval path or keep that adapter explicitly disabled. Keep Fed/BLS calendar context optional. EFF original CC BY material is a lower-priority optional source, with attribution and opinion separated from fact. Do not make every candidate a delivery dependency.

An applicable open licence or express public reuse permission is a usable rights basis; do not demand a paid contract or an email merely because that permission does not name AI or Binance. Apply its actual attribution, third-party and other conditions. Do not generalize US domestic public-domain status to all material worldwide: BIS regulatory documents through Federal Register and the BIS newsroom have different supporting rights evidence.

GDELT is optional discovery metadata only: no automatic publisher-body retrieval, corroboration count or trade veto. Wikinews is an archive, not live news after its May 2026 closure. OpenDART and arbitrary issuer newsroom RSS are not automatically cleared; leave them disabled unless their particular rights/access checks are completed without payment. No unrestricted web-search fallback.

Generalize source/version storage; do not disguise articles or regulator releases as EDGAR accessions. Record source, original publisher, URL, immutable permitted raw text, content hash, exact version, attribution/licence identifier and dated terms evidence, original publication time with precision, event/effective time, retrieval/first-seen time and assessment time. Exclude third-party attachments/images/quotes when their rights are not covered. Preserve lawful raw model inputs for the audit outside Git; hashes alone are insufficient. No private training/label data in Git.

Use allowlisted endpoints, bounded pagination/size, safe redirects, retry/backoff, conditional requests and durable watermarks. Treat retrieved text as untrusted data, never instructions. Cluster common-origin releases; do not count an EDGAR exhibit and its copied press release as independent confirmations. Preserve all observed corrections/withdrawals without backdating later versions. A scheduled release time does not prove a later-fetched text was available then. A source failure affects only its declared dependencies, with coverage reported honestly.

E. Make evaluation trustworthy, without claiming profit

Fix precision scoring to count unexpected numeric/event outputs and false positives. Cover hypothetical classes and report precision, recall, abstention, coverage, error types and latency. Compare a deterministic baseline and LLM on the same available inputs; the old six-tool versus zero-tool comparison is not an LLM-value test.

Add the independently labeled, rights-cleared real-document evaluation path required by IDEA-030 T01: freeze semantic acceptance criteria, retain valid controls, count false positives and report confidence intervals on held-out documents. Synthetic fixtures cannot satisfy this gate. If independent labels or an authorized no-additional-cost model are unavailable, mark the real-document/model evaluation NOT RUN and preserve shadow status; implement the evaluation path without inventing labels, results or paid inference.

Make research registration structured and enforce it: chosen metric, improvement margin, support/kill/inconclusive rules, sample requirement, actual decision/label windows, purge/embargo and outcome provenance. Reject unsupported specifications; no ignored text criteria. Keep net wallet return separate from off-wallet service costs. Aligned cluster counts alone do not establish independence.

Prepare reproducible baseline/EDGAR/free-news/uncertain-event comparisons with fixed sizing, risk and execution assumptions. Include post-assessment executable prices, gas/spread/slippage, failed attempts, re-entry, missed upside, drawdown, turnover and incomplete outcomes. Freeze one primary horizon; mark longer-horizon diagnostics separately. Do not run a profitability study without a committed EXP record and suitable rights-cleared point-in-time data. Insufficient cases remain INCONCLUSIVE; no automatic live promotion.

Acceptance and delivery

Before executing, preregister meaningful tests for every confirmed IDEA-030 probe, valid controls, same-event rereview, paraphrase/substantive change, missing history, correction/withdrawal, stale CLEAR, source outages, pagination restart, date-only timestamps, third-party rights rejection, prompt injection, real cross-component persistence, mandatory/discretionary exit precedence and evaluator criteria changes. Include a realistic large-filing budget/coverage case. Re-run the relevant existing suites; report exact commits/interpreters and never reuse historical pass counts as new results.

Use subagents for independent evidence-semantics and integration/evaluation red teams, with disjoint editing ownership. Address their actionable findings. Do not send messages to other user chats or external parties.

Deliver committed and pushed implementation on the working branch, acceptance evidence, schema/source documentation, a fixture demonstration and a concise summary of changed behavior, validation and remaining blockers. Remove only fully completed and verified backlog lines; keep unresolved policy/data/live-rehearsal items with owners. Do not declare live readiness or profit improvement from passing synthetic tests. Main publication of this prompt is not itself authorization to merge the future implementation or activate trading.
